supersedes: The 18 native version-3 file packages remain source material, not the final release after the owner's latest corrections.

schedule.rule: Move all 14 days together. No backfilling missed dates with mass posting; times are hypotheses pending account Insights.

protectedBrand.name: BAZAAR
protectedBrand.logoRule: Original asset in Latin, unchanged proportions. No translated or regenerated wordmark.
protectedBrand.typeRule: Keep the currently accepted clean dense sans-serif letterforms. Normalize headline weight and scale; do not introduce another font family. Inspect at equal canvas width and in the whole grid.
protectedBrand.fontFamilyStatus: Unknown in the original raster. Canva's automatic DM Sans reconstruction was visually different and is excluded.
protectedBrand.screenshotPlacement: Separate carousel slides, separate Story frames and separate Reel scenes. No interface screenshot over an illustrated or photographic card.
protectedBrand.screenshotTypography: Preserve real application typography. Do not retype, regenerate or retouch interface labels, statuses or values. Marketing headline consistency applies to illustrated cards.

editorialRules: One everyday task, an actual product example and one main next step per item.
Distinct concepts and industries, not a new heading over the same cosmetic still life.

Application screenshots are standalone slides/frames/scenes, never overlays on an illustration. Keep the illustrated card intact. Show large relevant application views on a separate clean page; never squeeze a whole desktop table into a phone-sized panel.
Screens come from the real current application using an isolated synthetic business. Label demonstration data in the material or accompanying caption.
AI photography is illustrative. Never present it as a client photo, actual testimonial or application result.
Do not invent successful AI processing, connected marketplaces, automatic fiscalization or business results.
Every carousel opening establishes the question, each middle slide adds information, and the final slide gives one next step.
Keep an intentional mix of photographic covers, actual product evidence and readable comparisons. Do not enforce a split-image puzzle or a checkerboard at the expense of each post.

research.application: One idea per slide, clear sequence, consistent typography, variation of layout and emphasis, mobile and profile-crop review.
Use account-specific guidance and Insights to evaluate posting frequency, attention and engagement. Do not present a universal best posting time.
Different creative concepts, simple paid structure and measured outcomes. No budget or paid launch inferred.
Use hierarchy and restrained font roles; the owner's current font choice takes precedence over choosing a new pairing.

profileGrid.model: New posts appear newest first; existing three posts remain in place. No assumption of pinned/reorder permissions.
profileGrid.rhythm: Keep the same original logo, blue-white setting and current headline style. Alternate photographic context, product evidence and comparison layouts. Inspect 4:5 files, 3:4 profile crops and mobile readability; do not use a fake grid as proof of publication.

primary: Cost per qualified lead after an approved paid test
secondary: Video retention and saves as content diagnostics
qualification: Decision maker or person involved in choosing the system
measurement.sourcePolicy: A Direct keyword is not proof of a paid source. Use Meta referral/ad ID when available, record self-report separately, and keep unknown attribution unknown.
measurement.paidTest: Prepare distinct checkout and stock-control concepts first. Do not launch, reserve spend or set a positive budget without owner approval.
measurement.iteration: Review qualified conversations, demonstrations and business registrations after week one. Change the second-week mix using evidence; do not infer a winner from followers or one day of low-volume data.

productionGates: New plan names and product/user quotas must appear consistently in text and images.

No repeated cosmetic still life across distinct modules; product variety and layout rhythm checked in chronological and profile views.
Actual external studio generation must be tested before showing a successful studio output; otherwise present only the verified interface and workflow.
New or changed assets exported natively, fully re-ingested, and approval hashes recomputed. Old version-3 approval cannot carry over.
Owner review of the complete revised package. No Instagram publication or paid launch implied.
